Grid Coated Paper

Grid Lacquer

Grid Coated Paper is medical grade packaging paper with heat sealable lacquer applied in a grid pattern. It is sterilization compatible, supports fibre free peeling and stays breathable because gases can pass through the open grid lines.

Talk to our team

Applications

  • Sterile medical packing
  • Heat seal pouches
  • Automatic online wrapping
  • Surgical glove packing
  • Syringe and catheter covers
  • Band aid wrappers

Key Properties

  • Heat sealability
  • Fiber free peeling
  • Breathable grid pattern
  • High strength
  • Virgin medical grade wood pulp
  • 5 10 GSM coating weight

Grid Coated Paper, Questions Answered

What is Grid Coated Paper used for?
Grid Coated Paper is used for sterile medical packing, heat seal pouches, automatic online wrapping, surgical glove packing, syringe and catheter covers.
Does KP Packaging manufacture or distribute Grid Coated Paper?
KP Packaging manufactures Grid Coated Paper in house at its Silvassa plant using extrusion coating and lamination.
What are the key features of Grid Coated Paper?
Heat sealability; Fiber free peeling; Breathable grid pattern; High strength.
